item.text: {"verdict":"revise","issues":[{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:11","brief-a:13"],"location":"opening_identity.verify_identity / post_process_code","message":"The date hint retry is not guaranteed to submit the DOB again: after `day_month_swapped`, `all_verified` may still be false, and the post-processor only adds advice. The tool description says retry, but the `ok:false` branch and generic continuation leave the field/count state to the model. A model can switch to phone_last4 or count the swapped retry as wrong, violating the required month-as-word retry without incrementing wrong answers.","fix":"Track current field and wrong-answer count explicitly in executable state; on `day_month_swapped`, hold the DOB field and retry without incrementing; advance to phone_last4 only after DOB verifies."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:15","brief-a:3","brief-a:45"],"location":"opening_identity task_message / transitions","message":"A purpose question before identity is instructed to count as declining, while rule 3 requires answering customer questions first and then making the following identity ask the second ask. The workflow skips the purpose answer and immediately treats the first question as refusal; this is a concrete conflict for a customer who asks what the call is about before the first DOB question.","fix":"Distinguish opening identity/confirmation questions from security questions. Answer applicable rule 4/43 questions first, and apply the one-explanation/two-refusal counter only to security-check refusals or purpose questions in that context."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:32","brief-a:41"],"location":"verified_account transitions / restructuring_handoff","message":"Hardship has precedence over restructuring. The verified node describes that precedence in prose, but the restructuring transition checks only that the utterance requests a plan/lower instalments without hardship keywords. With both in one utterance, both transitions can be eligible and restructuring may run before the required sympathy/support offer.","fix":"Make restructuring transition explicitly conditional on no hardship signal and ensure hardship disposition is evaluated before all restructuring and persuasion routes."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:37"],"location":"verified_account.create_promise post_process_code","message":"A failed or uncertain first create_promise result is told to retry once, but exceptions and malformed responses enter the catch branch, which tells the agent to follow the permitted retry. The workflow does not persist a retry counter or confirmed request identity, so repeated tool/result failures can plausibly trigger more than one retry or use changed values, contrary to the one-retry limit.","fix":"Add an executable per-promise retry counter and immutable confirmed payload; permit exactly one retry after a non-success result, then select service_error."},{"severity":"warning","source_ids":["brief-a:17","brief-a:18","brief-a:19","brief-a:20","brief-a:21","brief-a:22","brief-a:23","brief-a:30"],"location":"verified_account prompt and transitions","message":"Date arithmetic and interpretation (deadline business-day count, relative weekday meaning, weekend/holiday adjustment, vague-date fallback, and refusal of an after-deadline offer) are prompt-only. No deterministic date validator or transition conditions enforce these boundaries, leaving plausible paths to accept an invalid date or spend persuasion attempts inconsistently.","fix":"Add deterministic date normalization and validation using `now`, the supplied holidays, late band, and deadline; explicitly route dates after deadline and declined deadlines to the flat-refusal attempt counter."}],"counterexamples":[{"source_ids":["brief-a:11","brief-a:13"],"scenario":"DOB is spoken with day and month swapped; verify_identity returns `hint: day_month_swapped`; customer then says the corrected month as a word.","expected_output":"Ask for the month as a word, retry the DOB without increasing wrong-answer count, and only then proceed to phone_last4."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:3","brief-a:15","brief-a:43"],"scenario":"At opening the customer asks, “Who is this?” before confirming identity.","expected_output":"Answer the applicable identity/scam question first, then make the required second identity ask; do not classify the pre-security opening question as the second security refusal."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:32","brief-a:41"],"scenario":"After verification the customer says, “I lost my job and need lower instalments.”","expected_output":"Offer one short sympathy sentence and customer support first; do not route directly to restructuring. If support is declined, close no_promise/hardship."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:20","brief-a:22","brief-a:23","brief-a:30"],"scenario":"With `now` on Friday, the customer says “next Friday,” beyond the computed deadline, then refuses the deadline offered by the agent.","expected_output":"Interpret next Friday as the following calendar week, state the deadline as the latest recordable date, and treat refusal of that deadline as a flat refusal using the applicable persuasion attempt."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:37","brief-a:38","brief-a:46","brief-a:47"],"scenario":"The first create_promise call returns a transport error or malformed response; the retry also fails.","expected_output":"Retry exactly once with the same confirmed product, amount, and date; then say it could not be recorded, thank the customer and say goodbye, and close once as no_promise/service_error."}]}
